02 LEAGUE-WIDE NEWS THAT MOVES DECISIONS
ARSENAL / MAN CITY / CHELSEA
Saliba (back) is out; L'Equipe says he's targeting November.
That keeps Konsa/Gabriel nailed once fit.
ARS: Havertz has a hamstring problem (PI 25%). Rice is
expected fit (rumour). Mosquera, White and Hincapié are back
in training.
Man City were found guilty on the PL financial charges and
have appealed. Foden is suspended to 17 Oct; Semenyo 50%;
O'Reilly 50%.
CHE: João Pedro out to ~17/10 (PI; FPL flag 75% dates from
16 Sep). Palmer groin, 75%.
BOURNEMOUTH / LIVERPOOL / MAN UTD / SPURS
BOU: Alex Scott quad, out 6–8 weeks (GW11 at the earliest).
Kroupi and Kluivert also out, so Tavernier likely takes the
penalties.
LIV: Gakpo 50%, Ekitike out to ~Dec. Liverpool Echo: "nine
players could miss" City.
MUN: Dorgu hamstring. Mainoo, Amad, Rashford and Mazraoui
50%; de Ligt out. Bruno and Mbeumo fit.
TOT: Porro out to ~19/10, van Hecke 50%, Kulusevski out.
EVERTON / BRENTFORD / BRIGHTON
EVE: Mykolenko 50%. Barry fit and on pens.
BRE: Damsgaard ankle "bigger injury". Thiago and Schade fit.
BHA: Mitoma's return is being managed; Minteh out to ~24/10.
Dunk and Struijk 50%.
COVENTRY / NEWCASTLE / OTHERS
COV: Awoniyi suspended to 19/10 and Haji Wright out, so
Thomas-Asante starts.
NEW: Elanga, Dedic and Ramsey 25%; Burn 50% (mostly stale,
19 Sep).
CRY: Mateta ~11/10, Disasi suspended to 25/10. IPS: Fatawu
suspended to 17/10.

ARTICLES · COMPILED 5 OCT
Of the sources checked, only Harry, Mate, FFS and Planet FPL have published since the 4–5 Oct news (Haaland sub, Konsa knock, Scott injury, City verdict). The rest are 11–
15 days old and pre-break. Names in captions are often mangled; uncertain ones are marked (?). Not covered: FPL BlackBox and FPL General (stale) and FPL Sonaldo
(channel not found).
01 WHAT THEY SAID
FPL Harry 5 Oct · FRESH
"MY UPDATED FPL GW6 WILDCARD DRAFTS! So Many Injuries..!"
Wildcard: ~95% yes. Haaland is the only City player he keeps after the
verdict. He's cutting Wissa (weak data, missed pen) and Van Hecke,
and rules out Isak ("not worth the money"). Core across all 4 drafts:
Muharemović, Silva, Groß, Haaland, João Pedro. Won't pay £8m for
Gabriel. No GW6 captain named.
FPL Mate 5 Oct · FRESH (garbled captions)
"FPL GW6: Wildcard Team & Strategy (No Man City)"
Hypothetical WC draft, since he has already used his. No City players
at all. Kelleher; Gabriel, Konsa, De Cuyper, Silva, Muharemović(?);
Bruno, Saka, Rogers, Groß (+ probably Palmer); João Pedro, Gonzalo,
Barry. Captain Bruno (Spurs at home), Saka the alternative. Rates
Rogers better value than Palmer.
Let's Talk FPL 21–22 Sep · PRE-BREAK
"Wildcard team (Haaland AND Fernandes) / Early thoughts"
His own team isn't wildcarding (rolling). His WC draft:
Verbruggen/Kinsky; Cala fiori, Konsa, De Cuyper, Van Hecke, Silva;
Groß, Saka, Schade, Tavernier, Bruno; Haaland, Gonzalo, Barry.
Captain Bruno or Saka. Hold Bruno. Sell Sangaré before Szoboszlai.
FPL Raptor 20 Sep · PRE-BREAK
"4 FREE TRANSFERS | MY FPL GW6 TRANSFER PLANS"
No WC (used GW4). Sell list: Szoboszlai, Isak (looks un fit, not worth
£9.1m), Slater (dead slot). Plans: Slater → Groß/Tavernier plus Isak →
Gonzalo. Aggressive version adds Isak → Barry. Tentative captain
Haaland; "no standout".
FPL Focal 20 Sep · PRE-BREAK
"FPL GW6 TRANSFER PLANS"
No WC. Rolls if João Pedro is fit; otherwise Sangaré → King or
Tavernier/Schade. Prefers a double Arsenal defence plus Saka; Gabriel
not needed. Captain Palmer, VC Haaland. Leno and Affengruber for
cheap Fulham defence.
Fantasy Football Hub 24 Sep · PRE-BREAK
"The PERFECT Wildcard Draft For GW6!"
Raya; Konsa, Van Hecke, Wöber(?), a Brighton CB, Hall; Palmer, Saka,
Rogers, Groß, Schade; Haaland, Barry, Gonzalo. No Bruno; Haaland
kept for GW7 Ipswich. Captain Palmer. The Hub AI's own WC included
Le Fée(?) and Gabriel.
Fantasy Football Scout 24 Sep–5 Oct · articles
"GW6 WC best team · Scout Picks · injury news"
More than half of poll respondents are wildcarding. Pros: price rises,
break injuries, Fulham's promoted-team run, Bournemouth's run to
GW16. Cons: GW7 is a better Bournemouth entry and gives post-
Europe info. Konsa knock 'nothing major'; Haaland sub pre-planned.
Planet FPL 5 Oct · FRESH, no tips
"Man City's Guilty Verdict | S.10 Ep.11"
Explicitly not covering FPL this week; GW6 and WC drafts are due on
the Friday show. Their read on the verdict: likely "no punishment placed
this season", but it's a mindset question mark for City players.
